PROGRESS CHECKPOINT (execution of the approved 3-step plan):

STEP 1 — W3 health-lane bridge: **LANDED**. Gerrit change 2392 MERGED to origin/main (commit d0bcd620): REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB 102400->563200 (100->550 MiB) + self-documenting bridge comment naming restore ticket fluorspar-comparable-zeren (0894-b9b8-6590-4904); companion unit-test assertion updated. LLM-Review+1, Verified+1. The Verify-Authorship-Identity gate now has ~70 MiB headroom over today's 481 MiB pack — HEALTH LANE UNBLOCKED.

STEP 2 — Re-scope children: **DONE** (prior turn). Epic now owns the real levers (S1-S3 rewrite tooling; W1 batch write-lane; W2 root-tree shard); .retired children narrowed/retained with rationale.

STEP 3 — Build S0-S3 tooling (HARD STOP before prod mutation):
- S0 / ADR 0106 (866f unlikely-zealous-skua): **LANDED + CLOSED**. Gerrit change 2400 MERGED (commit 454f875). docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md (the causal-stability contract: N-day horizon, remote-reachability anchor, stale-clone forced-override, C1-C5 boundary, SNAPSHOT authorship-ledger carriage + enforce_since re-anchor, core-git rewrite primitive, per-backend publish-swap incl. S3 auto-doctor bypass, I1-I9 proof). concurrency.md §I1 promoted; ADR index + .numbers/0106 marker regenerated. Plan-review PASSED+signed (5 rounds); LLM-Review+1 & Verified+1. Closing 866f UNBLOCKED e32d + aff9.
- S1 (collapse engine, bdf3), S2 (publish-swap, 4b2a), S3 (dry-run, 8dc4): **NOT YET BUILT**. Dependency-order gate blocks claiming them until e32d + aff9 close. These are the substantive rewrite-tooling + held-out-TDD + dry-run deliverables — a multi-session effort.

PRE-SWAP GO/NO-GO: **NO-GO** for any prod tickets-branch rewrite/force-push — the S1-S3 tooling and its dry-run evidence do not exist yet. HARD STOP fully respected; no destructive op run. Next session: e32d -> aff9 -> S1 -> S2 -> S3 in dependency order, each plan-reviewed/claimed/landed via Gerrit, culminating in a shadow-clone dry-run proving verify-authorship stays clean + the pack shrinks as predicted.
